content.thinking:
All tests pass with debug-mode container bounds checking and UBSan.

Now let me test with resource limits to simulate the grader environment:
- 512 MiB address space (`ulimit -v 524288`)
- RLIMIT_NOFILE 256
- 1 CPU
- 30-second wall limit

Let me run the big cases under those limits.

Also test the stdout cap: 1M answers = 14 MB (or 6 MB for my big trace) — under 32 MiB ✓.

Let me run the 1M-trace lookup under `ulimit -v 524288` and `ulimit -n 256`.

content.text: Now let me verify under the grader's resource limits (512 MiB address space, 256 fds, 1 CPU):

arguments.command:
cd /work/tests && bash -c 'ulimit -v 524288; ulimit -n 256; ulimit -t 30; \
 ( time /work/submit/planb64 build big2.fib big2.idx ) 2>&1 | egrep "real|ERROR"; \
 ( time /work/submit/planb64 lookup big2.idx big.trace scalar > o.b2 ) 2>&1 | egrep "real|ERROR"; \
 ( time /work/submit/planb64 lookup big2.idx big.trace batch 256 > o.b3 ) 2>&1 | egrep "real|ERROR"; \
 cmp o.b2 o.b3 && echo "scalar==batch under limits OK"; wc -c o.b2'
echo "--- build of the 400001-row image under limits ---"
bash -c 'ulimit -v 524288; ulimit -n 256; /work/submit/planb64 build big2.fib /tmp/b2.idx && wc -l /tmp/b2.idx'
echo "--- memory of a 1M-trace lookup (peak RSS) ---"
bash -c 'ulimit -v 524288; /work/submit/planb64 lookup big2.idx big.trace scalar > /dev/null' ; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- empty image, empty trace, minimal cases under limits ---"
printf '' > /tmp/empty.fib; printf '' > /tmp/empty.tr; bash -c 'ulimit -v 524288; /work/submit/planb64 build /tmp/empty.fib /tmp/e.idx && cat /tmp/e.idx && /work/submit/planb64 lookup /tmp/e.idx /tmp/empty.tr scalar; echo "rc=$? (want 0, no output)"'
